name: music-content-engine
description: Desktop video editor for musicians: beat-synchronized edits, lyrics and batch content generation.
author: Pedro (Luneta)

scripts.postinstall: electron-builder install-app-deps && node scripts/fetch-ffmpeg.mjs && node scripts/fetch-whisper.mjs
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.node.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.web.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.e2e.json
scripts.test:e2e: node scripts/fetch-ffmpeg.mjs --strict && node scripts/fetch-whisper.mjs && electron-vite build && playwright test --project=dev
scripts.dist:win: node scripts/fetch-ffmpeg.mjs --target win32-x64 --strict && node scripts/fetch-whisper.mjs --target win32-x64 --strict && electron-vite build && electron-builder --win --publish never
